text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It feels like just yesterday when Falco
and the
others stood up there and...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's it! Let's all sing together!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So glad to have you, Suzuka! Let's do
this!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Songs have the power to convey
feelings. So just
sing with all your heart,
and I promise you'll do
great!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I just know we'll get new recruits today!
There
have to be more girls like us who
want to sing a
big "thank you"!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. I'm confident this concert will
be another
success. It must be!
